name: Stones Hold
note: Stones Hold is two cities in a mountain range. The UNDER CITY (99% of the people) fills a maze of twelve valleys wall to wall, its streets running round every cliff and bench, with an alpine lake held above it by a dam. The UPPER CITY (1%) is a concrete jungle on seventeen big nodes along the ridge blocks between the valleys: each a crown with a great building, a shelf and a terrace at different heights, packed with palaces, towers, houses and plazas, terraces of one block running together, and tall pointed-arch bridges at shared levels tying the blocks together, above all a statue-lined bridge from the Rival Cathedral to the Great Castle. Same layout as the Blender build (scripts/blender/sh_world.py); regenerate with scripts/blender/sh_recipe.py.

views.name: Under the umbrella
views.note: The under city: 99% of the people, houses stacked up the valleys in a maze round the cliffs and benches, the great bridges of the upper city roofing it.

views.name: Two cities
views.note: The whole hold: a maze of valleys full of the under city, and on the ridge blocks between them the upper city, seventeen dense nodes tied together by bridges.

views.name: The upper city
views.note: A concrete jungle on the heights: the eastern blocks seen from the south-east, palaces, towers, plazas and bridges all joined.

views.name: Over the great block
views.note: The Rival Cathedral on its block, the bridges to the Great Castle and the basilica.

views.name: The statue bridge
views.note: A kilometre and a half of bridge lined with statues on both sides, from the Rival Cathedral to the Great Castle.

views.name: The Great Castle
views.note: The castle at the end of the bridge: two rings of walls, a great keep, spired towers.

views.name: The arena
views.note: The arena block from the south-west: an arena, a citadel and a forum, terraces of houses between them.

views.name: The bridges
views.note: Tall pointed arches in one row, bridges at shared levels tying the blocks of the upper city together over the roofs of the under city.

views.name: The cathedral peak
views.note: The first cathedral on its crown, looking over the west and main valleys.

views.name: The dam and the lake
views.note: The glacial lake held above the old city by the dam.
